data.name: Avichal
data.gender_notes: Avichal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Avichal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'av' (radiant) and 'ichal' (illuminating). This name is associated with gods like Agni and Vishnu, symbolizing the inner light and divine presence. The name Avichal carries the meaning “Radiant or Illuminating” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avichal usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant or illuminating and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Avichal total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
